browse_remote_protocols.description: Protocols used to browse for remote printers (e.g., 'cups', 'ipp', 'https'). Use 'all' to enable all.

browse_local_protocols.description: Protocols used to browse for local printers (e.g., 'cups', 'dnssd' for mDNS/DNS-SD).

timeout.description: Number of seconds after which a discovered printer queue is removed if unused.

max_queued_printers.description: Maximum number of printer queues to keep. Set to 0 for unlimited.

create_remote_ipp_queue.description: Whether to create local CUPS printer queues for remote IPP/HTTP printers discovered via CUPS browsing.

create_ipp_printer.description: Whether to create queues for DNS-SD/Bonjour-discovered IPP printers (including driverless).

server_name.description: Hostname used to identify this CUPS server in queue names and logs.

listen_address.description: Network address cups-browsed should listen on (e.g., 'localhost', '*', '127.0.0.1', '::1').

port.description: Port for the local HTTP admin interface. Set to 0 to disable the interface.

debug_logging.description: Debug log verbosity: 0 = none, 1 = minimal, 2 = verbose.

filter_pattern.description: Regex pattern for printer names to exclude (ignored if empty).

browse_dnssd.description: Enable DNS-SD/Bonjour service discovery (required for mDNS printer discovery).

auto_install.description: Whether to automatically install drivers (if available) for discovered printers via driverless IPP.

default_attrs.description: List of default printer attributes (e.g., resolution, media size). Each item is a key/value pair.

printer_rules.description: Whitelist/blacklist rules for specific printers or domains (regex per line). Order matters — first match wins.

mode.description: Rule mode: 'Allow' to include, 'Deny' to exclude.

pattern.description: Regex pattern for matching printer names or URIs.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous HTTP connections to remote printers.

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support for service discovery and IPP communication.

discovery_time.description: Interval (seconds) between full discovery scans of the network.

ppd_search.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for PPD files when installing drivers.
